title: A sharp reversal threshold at four times the starting height
description:
In the 547/727 prime-ideal race, a gain and a loss greater than 269.364 log 2 both finish strictly before 3.999999997H on a set of starting heights of positive lower logarithmic density, unconditionally. If the eight odd factors satisfy the critical-line assertion, the upper limiting common normalized amplitude at 4H is 269.3640010193614394... . This deposit preserves the source from the original GitHub release.

Proof and hypotheses. Original release.
